items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember hearing a recording of Ravi Shankar with Louis Hayes.

ctx.x: She was touring with the Pops.

But again, that’s music that I really love. I remember hearing a recording of Ravi Shankar with Louis Hayes. This was a while ago. Louis Hayes and – it was with a jazz group. I remember that very well. So there’s lots of stuff to do.
You’re still a young man. There’s still a lot to do.
